response.justification: While Bogdan possesses over 15 years of solid software engineering experience and a strong entrepreneurial background, he lacks the deep, recognized AI/ML expertise and Director-level strategic advisory experience required for this Principal AI Strategy role. His AI experience appears limited to recent infrastructure tooling rather than driving enterprise-level AI strategy or major product differentiation.
strengths: Meets the minimum requirement of 15+ years of software and infrastructure engineering experience.
Entrepreneurial background as the Founder of GISCollective aligns with preferred qualifications.
Demonstrated ability to inspire and mentor others through technical talks, workshops, and open-source contributions.
concerns: Lacks the deep, recognized expertise in AI/ML and strategic AI-powered product development required for the role.
Missing Director-level experience in advising strategic enterprise customers on technology adoption and future state.
Does not possess the preferred Master's or PhD degree in an AI-related field.
